About

Founded in 1992 in Bhilwara of Rajasthan, Nitin Spinners is India’s leading manufacturer of cotton yarn, knitted fabrics and finished woven fabrics.

Key Points

Business Profile:[1]
Established in 1992 and headquartered
in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, the company is
one of India’s leading manufacturers of
Cotton & Blended Yarn, Knitted Fabrics,
and Greige & Finished Woven Fabrics.
With a presence in 55+ countries and
a strong distribution network, it is one
of the leading global players in the textile industry.
